Name: Skateboard For 1.6
Author: chiccenSDV
Description:
This mod is gnarly, dude.

[youtube]uNPrgXEMNCs[/youtube]


Don't forget your brain buckets, posers!

[i]Disclaimer: aedenthorn is not a skateboarder. But I am, and this mod is close enough.[/i]


[size=5]Getting a Board[/size]

You can like craft a complete in the totally radical crafting menu using:

[list]
[*]4 Hardwood (for the custom maple deck)
[*]1 Iridium Bar (for bodacious bearings)
[*]1 Iron Bar (for truck, coping, etc.)
[*]1 Refined Quartz (for grip tape)
[*]10 Sap (for risers, wheels, grip tape)
[/list]
You can also type skateboard into the SMAPI console to get a complete board for free - excellent!


[size=5]Usage[/size]

To ride, hold a complete board and press the ride button (default Right Mouse). To bail, press the ride button again.

If you get stuck on something, bail.

I recommend using this mod with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21054]Yet Another Jump Mod[/url], both for performing wicked techs and for getting unstuck. ([i]uploader note: I haven't tested 1.6 compatibility[/i])

This mod sometimes ignores collisions with removable objects, let's just call it a feature.


[size=5]Config[/size]

You can totally change not only the above most excellent requirements in the config, but also max speed, acceleration, deceleration, and the ride button.


[size=5]Custom Boards[/size]

You can change the board texture (found at [CP] Skateboard/assets/Skateboard.png) using Content Patcher and targeting the following path:

Mods/chiccen.SkateboardCP/Skateboard

Custom Boards that work with this mod include (uploader note, I haven't tested these but it's probably fine):

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13100]Back to the Future Hoverboard skin[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13116]Simple Skateboard Retextures[/url]﻿
[/list]
